# id: # scope: owner:OWNER (the repository's owner) or claude:TEXT (the repository's CLAUDE.md holds TEXT).
# paths: a regular expression over the changed path. added: over the lines the diff adds to it ("-" none).
# content: over the file at the head ("-" none). needle: the Plan row that meets the gate holds it.
# source: REPOSITORY/FILE: the sentence of that file the gate is made from, word for word.

form: a numbered row that cites the bats-lang/relock-scratch run and job (https://github.com/bats-lang/relock-scratch/actions/runs/RUN/job/JOB) with the complete log of the step that matters
source: repository-prototype/CLAUDE.md: The body of a pull request that changes such a workflow cites that run and its job (`https://github.com/bats-lang/relock-scratch/actions/runs/<run>/job/<job>`) with the complete log of the step that matters.

form: a numbered row that runs `bats check-pins` on the workflows
source: repository-prototype/CLAUDE.md: `publish.yml` and `relock-pins.yml` here (and pwa's `android.yml` for an app) are called by commit, never `@main`.

form: a numbered row that commits the regenerated bootstrap/c (the CI artifact bootstrap-c-regenerated-HEAD_SHA) in the same PR
source: bats/CLAUDE.md: Every change to `src/` or `bats.lock` must commit a regenerated `bootstrap/c` in the same PR.

form: a numbered row that runs `bats lock --repository DIR` or `bats check-pins` and shows the lock matches
source: pwa/CLAUDE.md: A pull request that needs newer packages runs `bats lock --repository <dir>` and commits `bats.lock` (and `.github/repository-version`) with the change.

form: a numbered row that shows the old form kept beside the new one, the test that calls it, and the p2 ticket that removes it
source: repository-prototype/CLAUDE.md: A package's API or type change is additive: the old form stays beside the new one for one published version, and a test calls it.

form: a numbered row that quotes the owner's authorization, his words and their date
source: repository-prototype/CLAUDE.md: **Packages must never be made `unsafe = true`** without explicit user authorization.

form: a numbered row that runs `sha256sum` on the file and shows the hash the CLAUDE.md lists
source: capacitor-plugins/CLAUDE.md: `review-gate.yml` and `review-gate-relay.yml` are byte-identical copies of bridge's, so a hash comparison shows they are the canonical gate.
